notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to white is at least seven.
description:
Activate Nykthos by paying {2} and tapping it, adding at least seven {W}.
Activate Candelabra of Tawnos by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Nykthos.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Candelabra of Tawnos from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Candelabra of Tawnos by paying {1}.
Repeat.
